title: Prototyping Horizon Charge II: Sunward
body:
A solar craft on a floating neon highway, chasing the last light above an alien cloud sea. Here's a look at the current Solar Dart in flight, its hull, and its glowing twin thrusters. Still a work in progress.

![Horizon Charge II: Sunward flight view with the Solar Dart on a neon highway above clouds, facing the sun.](../media/horizon-charge-ii-2026-10-04-prototyping-sunward/first-light-flight.png)

![Front three-quarter studio view of the Solar Dart, showing its pointed hull, faceted canopy, and cyan guidance strips.](../media/horizon-charge-ii-2026-10-04-prototyping-sunward/studio-front.png)

![Rear three-quarter view of the Solar Dart on the highway, showing twin cyan thrusters and articulated control surfaces.](../media/horizon-charge-ii-2026-10-04-prototyping-sunward/first-light-rear.png)

![Close-up inside a Solar Dart thruster, showing the hollow bore, metal rim, and three glowing cyan field coils.](../media/horizon-charge-ii-2026-10-04-prototyping-sunward/studio-bore.png)
